speaker: P1298
text: If I could go back in time and give advice to my younger self, I think I would tell her to chill out and not take everything. Everything is not that deep. Because when I was in high school and college especially, I just took everything so seriously and I was in such a rush. I never slowed down and really lived in the moment and enjoyed things. And being a bit older now, I look back and I'm like, hmm, maybe I should have just taken my time and really lived in the moment instead of just wasting it and anxiously thinking about the future.

speaker: P1297
text: It's funny because mine would probably be the opposite. I had too much fun and I didn't pay enough attention to the scholastics of things.
